title: Buy 2, Get 1 Free Select DVD, Blu-Ray, 4K UHD Movies & TV Shows + Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store) @ JB Hi-Fi
body:
Deal: Buy 2, Get 1 Free Select DVD, Blu-Ray, 4K UHD Movies & TV Shows + Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store) @ JB Hi-Fi

[mahd-mahn] Wow 2.5 month sale haha. I assume this will stack as usual with Black Friday/boxing day 20% off. Getting in early with the B2G1F sale, get the early adopters out of the way, then hit the double sale later.
[xxssmmmmxx] If they follow with what they did last year, could be 30% off in three weeks' time.
[mahd-mahn] Right limited selection of 84 4ks compared to their usual 800 library. A few good demo discs in there worth getting if you don't already have them. I love ready player one and fury road. Fury road makes me happy every time I watch/hear it.
[viirgon] Nothing worth getting from the 84 4Ks selection.
[Odin] Angel's Egg
Lawrence Arabia(bit expensive but if it's the freebie)
Matrix
Fury Road
[brotherfranciz] Lawrence Arabia(bit expensive but if it's the freebie)
The cheapest one is free. This has been the case since the dawn of time of these JB Hi-Fi B2G1F sales…
[Munkeyalan] Which is why they said it's expensive but worth getting if you can get it as the freebie, i.e. with two more expensive items.
[caitsith01] Hooray, a great bargain of 3 for 2 on 4k disks that are checks notes $55 each!
[xxssmmmmxx] Hooray for having no interest in 4K.
There's likely to be 30% off in a few weeks, so only $38.50 each or three for $77
